summary: Verified tint-vto React remount bug fix on /xofit-frame-fitting (Fit.jsx). Ran the exact repro sequence: click 'Try xoFrame Demo' -> switch to xoFit Core -> switch to xoFit Mobile -> switch back to xoFrame -> click demo again, repeated 3 cycles. Result: document.querySelectorAll('tint-vto').length stayed at 1 throughout all cycles (never duplicated/torn down), typeof document.querySelector('tint-vto').open remained 'function' at every checkpoint, and ZERO console errors (including no 'is not a function' TypeError) were captured across the whole flow. Fix confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: Fit.jsx (685 lines) is on the larger side but still single-responsibility (one page component with tab data); no immediate split required.
openVTO() correctly guards on customElements.get('tint-vto') before falling back to script injection - clean re-entrant logic.
tint-vto element placed once at top of return, outside AnimatePresence/tab conditional - correct fix location per the described root cause.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix independently verified via Playwright: tint-vto singleton count=1 and typeof .open==='function' held across 3 full tab-switch cycles (core->mobile->frame) with repeated demo-button clicks; 0 console errors total. Regression checks also passed: xoFit Core tab (6 tiles + features section) and xoFit Mobile tab (6 tiles + features section) render fully. xoFrame intro image measured 1080px wide (well over the 1000px threshold) with a fully transparent background (rgba(0,0,0,0) on wrapper) - the earlier image-size/background fix has not regressed. Widget does visibly open to its loading-spinner UI (as expected, camera permission/live feed not testable in headless sandbox per instructions). Network monitoring during widget open captured 33 requests to tintvto.com/cdn.tintvto.sdk.banuba.net, ALL returned 200 (no 403s observed in this run) - the previously reported S3 AccessDenied CDN issue on fonts.css/theme.css did not reproduce this time; noting as informational only per instructions (not in scope to fix, and did not block the widget UI from opening this run).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - this was fix verification, not new bug investigation. Original RCA (React remounting <tint-vto> on every AnimatePresence tab switch, losing the SDK's internally-wired .open() reference) was already documented by main agent; fix of hoisting the element to page level (outside the per-tab conditional) is confirmed effective by this test.
